answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a opal that rotates unpredictably. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra timber buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The vine ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 10frv.
